2607.06326.title: DT-Guard: Intent-Driven Reasoning-Active Training for Reasoning-Free LLM Safety Guardrail
2607.06326.paper_summary: Large language models deployed in open-world applications require safety guardrails that are both robust to complex risks and efficient enough for low-latency runtime moderation. Existing guardrails face a practical trade-off between lightweight classification-based models, which are efficient but often struggle with concealed intent, ambiguous semantics, and borderline safety decisions, and reasoning-based guards, which improve judgment quality but introduce additional token generation and inference latency. We present DT-Guard, a content safety guardrail model based on a Reasoning-Active Training, Reasoning-Free Inference paradigm. The key idea is to use reasoning supervision during training while emitting only structured safety labels at inference time. DT-Guard formulates safety judgment as a progressive decision process, Intent - Category - Safety, and constructs an intent-driven dataset with intent labels, risk categories, safety labels, and structured reasoning trajectories. To further improve hard-case robustness, we propose Rollout-Guided Progressive Hard-Case Optimization (RG-PHO), which uses multi-rollout consistency to identify stably mastered, persistently failed, and preference-unstable samples, and applies targeted supervised and preference optimization accordingly. At inference time, DT-Guard directly generates structured labels without explicit reasoning traces, preserving deployment efficiency. Experiments on prompt-side and response-side safety benchmarks show that DT-Guard achieves average F1 scores of 0.886 and 0.870, respectively. With only a 4B backbone, it reaches a dual-side average F1 of 0.878, outperforming strong 8B guardrail baselines. These results demonstrate that reasoning supervision can be effectively internalized into low-latency safety discrimination.
2607.06326.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在開放世界應用中需要安全護欄，這些護欄必須對複雜風險具有穩健性，並且足夠高效以支持低延遲的運行時監控。現有的護欄在輕量級基於分類的模型（雖然高效，但通常在隱藏意圖、模糊語義和邊界安全決策方面面臨挑戰）與基於推理的護欄（提高判斷質量，但引入額外的標記生成和推理延遲）之間存在實際的權衡。 我們提出了DT-Guard，一種基於推理主動訓練和無推理推斷範式的內容安全護欄模型。關鍵思想是在訓練期間使用推理監督，而在推斷時僅發出結構化的安全標籤。DT-Guard將安全判斷公式化為一個漸進的決策過程，即意圖 - 類別 - 安全，並構建了一個意圖驅動的數據集，該數據集包含意圖標籤、風險類別、安全標籤和結構化推理軌跡。為了進一步提高難例的穩健性，我們提出了滾動引導的漸進難例優化（RG-PHO），它利用多次滾動一致性來識別穩定掌握、持續失敗和偏好不穩定的樣本，並相應地應用有針對性的監督和偏好優化。在推斷時，DT-Guard直接生成結構化標籤，而不需要明確的推理痕跡，從而保持部署效率。在提示端和回應端的安全基準實驗中，DT-Guard分別達到了平均F1分數0.886和0.870。僅用4B的骨幹，它達到了雙側平均F1 0.878，超越了強大的8B護欄基準。這些結果顯示，推理監督可以有效地內化到低延遲的安全判別中。
